# RP calculations

```{r}
# Bisphenol concentrations
BPA_f <- 1.46
BPS_f <- 0.29

BPA_m <- 0.61
BPS_m <- 0.18


# BPS potency relative to BPA
# numerator = BPS effect
# denominator = BPA effect

RP_BPS_vs_BPA_values <- c(
  Korea = log(2.13) / log(1.44),
  France_Q2 = log(2.81) / log(2.56),
  France_Q3 = log(2.81) / log(2.35),
  France_Q4 = log(2.81) / log(1.56)
)

# saving the different RP scenarios
RP_BPS_vs_BPA <- c(
  lower = min(RP_BPS_vs_BPA_values),
  median = median(RP_BPS_vs_BPA_values),
  upper = max(RP_BPS_vs_BPA_values)
)

df_bisphenol_BPS_eq <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    group = "Male",
    original_group = "Fathers",
    BPA_original = BPA_f,
    BPS_current = BPS_f,
    RP_scenario = names(RP_BPS_vs_BPA),
    RP_BPS_vs_BPA = RP_BPS_vs_BPA
  ),
  tibble(
    group = "Female",
    original_group = "Mothers",
    BPA_original = BPA_m,
    BPS_current = BPS_m,
    RP_scenario = names(RP_BPS_vs_BPA),
    RP_BPS_vs_BPA = RP_BPS_vs_BPA
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Amount of BPS needed to give the same estimated effect as the original BPA
    BPA_as_BPS_eq = BPA_original / RP_BPS_vs_BPA,
    
    # Baseline model input
    # current BPA + BPS mixture expressed as BPS-equivalent exposure
    baseline_mixture_BPS_eq = BPA_as_BPS_eq + BPS_current,
    
    # Substitution model input
    # actual BPS exposure after full 1:1 replacement of BPA by BPS
    # will always be the same
    substitution_BPS_dose = BPA_original + BPS_current,
    
    # change between the values in percent
    pct_change_substitution_vs_baseline =
      ((substitution_BPS_dose - baseline_mixture_BPS_eq) /
         baseline_mixture_BPS_eq) * 100
  )

df_bisphenol_BPS_eq
```

## Korean diabetes DOSE-RESPONSE model

```{r}
# Korean ORs
OR_t2  <- 1.73
LCL_t2 <- 1.00
UCL_t2 <- 2.98

OR_t3  <- 2.13
LCL_t3 <- 1.29
UCL_t3 <- 3.50

# uncertainty from CI
se_t2 <- (log(UCL_t2) - log(LCL_t2)) / (2 * 1.96)
se_t3 <- (log(UCL_t3) - log(LCL_t3)) / (2 * 1.96)

# fitting a lognormal distribution
fit_kor <- get.lnorm.par(
  p = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
  q = c(0.029, 0.049, 0.104),
  show.output = FALSE,
  plot = TRUE
)

# extract the fitted lognormal parameters as ordinary numbers
meanlog_kor <- unname(fit_kor["meanlog"])
sdlog_kor   <- unname(fit_kor["sdlog"])

# Simulate Korean detectable exposure distribution
# If detectable Korean BPS is lognormal, what concentrations are typical in tertiles 1, 2, and 3?
set.seed(123)
x_kor <- rlnorm(1e6, meanlog = meanlog_kor, sdlog = sdlog_kor)

# Tertile cutpoints among detectable Korean values
cut1 <- qlnorm(1/3, meanlog = meanlog_kor, sdlog = sdlog_kor)
cut2 <- qlnorm(2/3, meanlog = meanlog_kor, sdlog = sdlog_kor)

# finding the typical dose within the tertile
# cuts represent the boundaries between the tertiles
dose_t1 <- mean(x_kor[x_kor <= cut1])
dose_t2 <- mean(x_kor[x_kor > cut1 & x_kor <= cut2])
dose_t3 <- mean(x_kor[x_kor > cut2])

# setting reference dose
x_ref <- dose_t1


## Build dose-response dataset and fit linear trend ##
# dose = representative exposures (means) for the 3 tertiles
# dose_c = making tertile 1 the reference point/baseline where log(RR)=0, RR=1
# IS dose_c NECESSARY?
# logrr = converting the RR to the log scale
# se = using the SE for the log-risk estimates
study_dat <- tibble(
  dose   = c(dose_t1, dose_t2, dose_t3),
  dose_c = c(dose_t1, dose_t2, dose_t3) - dose_t1,
  logrr  = log(c(1, OR_t2, OR_t3)),
  se     = c(NA, se_t2, se_t3)
)

# fitting linear model, trying to finde the slope beta of the best straight line
# lm(logrr ~ 0 + dose_c) fits the line without an intercept to force it through (0,0) 
# this means dose_c = 0, logrr = 0 which makes 1 at reference dose (RR = e^logrr = 1, where logrr = 0)
# data = study_dat[2:3, ], uses just tertile 2 and 3 (removes the first row) because tertile 1 is reference
fit_lin <- lm(
  logrr ~ 0 + dose_c,
  data = study_dat[2:3, ],
  weights = 1 / study_dat$se[2:3]^2
)

# estimated slope of line + uncertainty of the estimated slope
beta_hat <- unname(coef(fit_lin)["dose_c"])
beta_se  <- summary(fit_lin)$coefficients["dose_c", "Std. Error"]
```

## Danish Diabetes burden inputs

```{r}
# Danish diabetes inputs
df_diabetes <- read_excel(
  "/Users/idasofieadrian/Desktop/DTU/SPECIALE/Speciale/data/diabetes korea (GBD).xlsx"
) %>%
  mutate(
    meanlog_dk = log(p_50),
    sdlog_dk = (log(p_75) - log(p_25)) / (qnorm(0.75) - qnorm(0.25)),
    p_detectable_dk = 1 - plnorm(LOD, meanlog_dk, sdlog_dk),
    mean_exp_dk = exp(meanlog_dk + 0.5 * sdlog_dk^2),
    median_dk = p_50
  )


# YLL inputs

yll_f <- 7896.75
yll_m <- 12928.04

# adding to dataframe
df_diabetes <- df_diabetes %>%

    deaths = case_when(
      str_detect(group, "^Female") ~ deaths_f,
      str_detect(group, "^Male") ~ deaths_m,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_

    seyll = case_when(
      str_detect(group, "^Female") ~ seyll_f,
      str_detect(group, "^Male") ~ seyll_m,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

## PERT

```{r}
rpert <- function(n, min, mode, max) {
  alpha <- 1 + 4 * (mode - min) / (max - min)
  beta  <- 1 + 4 * (max - mode) / (max - min)
  min + rbeta(n, alpha, beta) * (max - min)
}
```

## Monte Carlo

```{r}
run_mc_row_health_impact <- function(
    baseline_exposure, substitution_exposure,
    p_detectable_dk,
    deaths, seyll,
    prev_mode, prev_lower, prev_upper,
    YLD_mode, YLD_lower, YLD_upper,
    beta_hat, beta_se, x_ref
) {
  
  beta <- rnorm(1, mean = beta_hat, sd = beta_se)
  
  prev_draw <- rpert(
    1,
    min = prev_lower,
    mode = prev_mode,
    max = prev_upper
  )
  
  YLD_total_draw <- rpert(
    1,
    min = YLD_lower,
    mode = YLD_mode,
    max = YLD_upper
  )
  
  calc_burden <- function(exposure_input) {
    rr <- exp(beta * (exposure_input - x_ref))
    
    PAF <- (p_detectable_dk * (rr - 1)) /
      (1 + p_detectable_dk * (rr - 1))
    
    AP <- PAF * prev_draw
    AD <- PAF * deaths
    YLD_prevalence <- PAF * YLD_total_draw
    YLL <- AD * seyll
    DALY_prevalence <- YLD_prevalence + YLL
    
    tibble(
      PAF = PAF,
      AP = AP,
      AD = AD,
      YLD_prevalence = YLD_prevalence,
      YLL = YLL,
      DALY_prevalence = DALY_prevalence
    )
  }
  
  baseline <- calc_burden(baseline_exposure)
  substitution <- calc_burden(substitution_exposure)
  
  tibble(
    PAF_baseline = baseline$PAF,
    PAF_substitution = substitution$PAF,
    health_impact_PAF = substitution$PAF - baseline$PAF,
    
    AP_baseline = baseline$AP,
    AP_substitution = substitution$AP,
    health_impact_AP = substitution$AP - baseline$AP,
    
    AD_baseline = baseline$AD,
    AD_substitution = substitution$AD,
    health_impact_AD = substitution$AD - baseline$AD,
    
    YLD_prevalence_baseline = baseline$YLD_prevalence,
    YLD_prevalence_substitution = substitution$YLD_prevalence,
    health_impact_YLD_prevalence =
      substitution$YLD_prevalence - baseline$YLD_prevalence,
    
    YLL_baseline = baseline$YLL,
    YLL_substitution = substitution$YLL,
    health_impact_YLL = substitution$YLL - baseline$YLL,
    
    DALY_prevalence_baseline = baseline$DALY_prevalence,
    DALY_prevalence_substitution = substitution$DALY_prevalence,
    health_impact_DALY_prevalence =
      substitution$DALY_prevalence - baseline$DALY_prevalence
  )
}

```

```{r}
run_mc_summary_health_impact <- function(
    baseline_exposure, substitution_exposure,
    p_detectable_dk,
    deaths, seyll,
    prev_mode, prev_lower, prev_upper,
    YLD_mode, YLD_lower, YLD_upper,
    beta_hat, beta_se, x_ref,
    nsim_outer = 1000
) {
  
  sims <- map_dfr(seq_len(nsim_outer), ~
                    run_mc_row_health_impact(
                      baseline_exposure = baseline_exposure,
                      substitution_exposure = substitution_exposure,
                      p_detectable_dk = p_detectable_dk,
                      deaths = deaths,
                      seyll = seyll,
                      prev_mode = prev_mode,
                      prev_lower = prev_lower,
                      prev_upper = prev_upper,
                      YLD_mode = YLD_mode,
                      YLD_lower = YLD_lower,
                      YLD_upper = YLD_upper,
                      beta_hat = beta_hat,
                      beta_se = beta_se,
                      x_ref = x_ref
                    )
  )
  
  tibble(
    PAF_baseline_med = median(sims$PAF_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    PAF_substitution_med = median(sims$PAF_substitution, na.rm = TRUE),
    health_impact_PAF_med = median(sims$health_impact_PAF, na.rm = TRUE),
    health_impact_PAF_lo = quantile(sims$health_impact_PAF, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    health_impact_PAF_hi = quantile(sims$health_impact_PAF, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    DALY_baseline_med = median(sims$DALY_prevalence_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    DALY_substitution_med = median(sims$DALY_prevalence_substitution, na.rm = TRUE),
    health_impact_DALY_prevalence_med =
      median(sims$health_impact_DALY_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
    health_impact_DALY_prevalence_lo =
      quantile(sims$health_impact_DALY_prevalence, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    health_impact_DALY_prevalence_hi =
      quantile(sims$health_impact_DALY_prevalence, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

## Health Impact

```{r}
set.seed(123)

health_impact <- df_model_input %>%
  mutate(
    mc = pmap(
      list(
        baseline_mixture_BPS_eq,
        substitution_BPS_dose,
        p_detectable_dk,
        deaths,
        seyll,
        prev_mode,
        prev_lower,
        prev_upper,
        YLD_mode,
        YLD_lower,
        YLD_upper
      ),
      ~ run_mc_summary_health_impact(
        baseline_exposure = ..1,
        substitution_exposure = ..2,
        p_detectable_dk = ..3,
        deaths = ..4,
        seyll = ..5,
        prev_mode = ..6,
        prev_lower = ..7,
        prev_upper = ..8,
        YLD_mode = ..9,
        YLD_lower = ..10,
        YLD_upper = ..11,
        beta_hat = beta_hat,
        beta_se = beta_se,
        x_ref = x_ref,
        nsim_outer = 1000
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(mc)
```

## 

```{r}
population_male   <- 2964866
population_female <- 2999193

health_impact_100k <- health_impact %>%
  mutate(
    population = case_when(
      str_detect(group, "^Male")   ~ population_male,
      str_detect(group, "^Female") ~ population_female
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        DALY_baseline_med,
        DALY_substitution_med,
        health_impact_DALY_prevalence_med,
        health_impact_DALY_prevalence_lo,
        health_impact_DALY_prevalence_hi
      ),
      ~ .x / population * 100000,
      .names = "{.col}_100k"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-population)

write_xlsx(
  health_impact_100k,
  "/Users/idasofieadrian/Desktop/DTU/SPECIALE/Speciale/results/health_impact_100k.xlsx"
```
